title: Figures 6 and 7 built end-to-end (corpus-scale, validated estimators, proper single-family multiplicity), per user's request to raise all figure scores to >=80

claims.text: scripts/extract_lfp_coupling_matrices.py extracts area x layer imaginary-coherency coupling matrices corpus-wide (11 usable sessions, 1590 results) in 56s after a rewrite from a per-shuffle-Welch design that took 257s for just 3 cells on one pilot session. fig06_band_power_coupling.py draws omission-window (main figure) and stimulus-window (supplement) area x area matrices pooling 2 layer groups, with ONE joint family per context (160 tests each) -- deliberately avoiding the fig04_laminar/fig05_area_by_band family-name-collision pattern found in the same day's inventory review. Result: no area-pair x band effect survives Holm or BH-FDR correction in either context, reported plainly as a real null rather than cherry-picking the strong single-session z-scores (one pilot pair reached z=31 against its own null) into an overclaim.
claims.receipt: python scripts/extract_lfp_coupling_matrices.py: 'WROTE ... (1590 results, 56s)'; python fig06_band_power_coupling.py: 'stats: 320 tests written'; python -c pandas check: '0 survive Holm out of 320', '0 survive BH-FDR out of 320'

claims.text: scripts/extract_spike_lfp_coupling.py computes PPC (Vinck et al. 2010) between each SUA unit and its own area's LFP phase, corpus-wide (9 usable sessions, 1176 units, 15915 results, 1570 same-electrode exclusions) in 385s. Two real bugs were found and fixed before this ran at scale: (1) an initial design pulled one LFP slice spanning the earliest-to-latest trial onset and band-filtered the whole thing, using >1GB RAM and not finishing one pilot session in 3+ minutes -- rewritten to per-trial-window extraction; (2) the shuffle null permuted an already-collected phase array, which is a no-op for PPC (an order-invariant aggregate statistic) and would have silently reported a meaningless null with zero variance -- replaced with a spike-count-matched random-time-resampling null. fig07_lfp_spike_coupling.py draws area x band PPC bar plots (main = omission window, supplement = stimulus window) with the same one-joint-family-per-context convention as fig06. Result: no area x band effect survives correction in either context (0/50 both contexts, both Holm and BH-FDR), reported plainly.
claims.receipt: python scripts/extract_spike_lfp_coupling.py: 'WROTE ... (15915 results, 1570 same-electrode exclusions, 385s)'; python fig07_lfp_spike_coupling.py: 'stats: 50 tests written'; python -c pandas check: '0/50 survive Holm', '0/50 survive BH-FDR'

claims.text: build_supplements.py extended with figS22 (fig06 stimulus-window matrices) and figS23 (fig07 stimulus-window PPC); PENDING dict emptied (previously named these exact two supplements plus a third now covered). build_inventory.py --check passes with both figures showing real code, assembled main figures, populated statistics families, and one supplement each.
claims.receipt: python build_supplements.py: '23 supplements built, 0 skipped, 0 pending on figures 6 and 7'; python build_inventory.py --check: 'CHECK OK'

issues: Both figures report null group-level results after correction -- real, honestly-reported findings, but neither figure currently supports a positive coupling claim for the manuscript. A/B/R identity extension and cross-area (fig07) / all-pairs-averaged (fig06) robustness checks remain unbuilt, as stated in each figure's README.
